scenes.text: You've got a chest full of gold. And someone wants it.
Every night, they walk right up and take it.
So you tie it shut. They cut the rope.
So you drop a massive rock on top. They shove it off.
Fine. A wooden bolt through a latch. They just slide it open.
So you get smart. You drop pins into the bolt, pushed down by springs. Now nobody can slide it.
Not even you. So you carve a key. Its bumps lift every pin to the perfect height, and the bolt slides free.
The thief is done. And you just invented the lock and key.
Egyptians used this same trick four thousand years ago. It's probably in your front door right now.
